title: DeLonge already had ten advisers by November 2014
summary: Jason Simosa tells of DeLonge already had ten advisers by November 2014, about 2014 at United States (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: But Peter Levenda, who was someone who worked closely with DeLonge, he said by the time he joined, which was November 2014, there were already 10 advisers.

plain: A researcher named Jason Simosa, speaking on Jesse Michels's podcast, talks about Tom DeLonge, a rock musician who started a public effort to reveal UFO secrets. Simosa says the writer Peter Levenda, who worked closely with DeLonge, told him that when he joined in November 2014 there were already ten advisers. That would mean DeLonge's circle of insiders formed earlier than people knew.
